subject: general
question: A, B, C, D, E and F are sitting around a circular table facing the centre. Only two people sit between F and C. D sits to an immediate right of F. A is an immediate neighbour of B and C. What is the position of E with respect to B?
solution:
Given: A, B, C, D, E and F are sitting around a circular table facing the centre.

Only two people sit between F and C.

D sits to an immediate right of F.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/11f809cfd17f3ce6065be29d19c0bf48d5702c3b8fc17c3ce3d30a0f3440c041.png] 

A is an immediate neighbour of B and C.

Thus, final arrangement:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7da554baae4b9b9a9586e5fd7bd275295524e136ed58d9a75f961826844c69eb.png] 

So, '**Third to the right**" is the position of E with respect to B.

Hence, the correct answer is **"Third to the right".**
